query: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS name, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','dation_private') AND p.proname IN ('enqueue_dispatch_run','finish_dispatch_job','approve_decision_run_version','invalidate_run_lineage','reopen_on_run_admission','apply_case_attributes','platform_rpc','record_decision_chat_turn_with_evidence') ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname;

functions.name: apply_case_attributes
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dation_private.apply_case_attributes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 NEW.attributes_applied_at=CASE WHEN nullif(trim(NEW.label),'') IS NOT NULL AND NEW.category IS NOT NULL THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

functions.name: approve_decision_run_version
functions.identity_arguments: target_run_id uuid, target_case_id uuid, target_node_id text

functions.name: enqueue_dispatch_run
functions.identity_arguments: run_payload jsonb, job_request jsonb, intent_fingerprint text, queue_limit integer

functions.name: finish_dispatch_job
functions.identity_arguments: target_run_id uuid, worker_token uuid, terminal_values jsonb

functions.name: invalidate_run_lineage
record_decision_chat_turn_with_evidence
functions.identity_arguments: target_turn_id uuid, target_run_id uuid, intent_hash text, question_text text, answer_text text, metadata jsonb, evidence_analysis_id uuid

functions.name: reopen_on_run_admission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dation_private.reopen_on_run_admission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN PERFORM dation_private.invalidate_run_lineage(NEW); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

functions.name: platform_rpc
functions.identity_arguments: target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, operation text, arguments jsonb, worker_call boolean
